integrity: The idempotent-product graph relation over quadratically closed fields is acknowledged as prior work. Exact finite-field fibers and a ternary discriminant boundary are assessed in this result. Finite computations are not substituted for a universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Nondegenerate spin-factor Jordan algebras over odd finite fields, dimension at least 3, only ordered products of two nontrivial idempotents. Potential unindexed equivalent sphere-intersection formulas remain a bibliographic risk; no independent auditing.
title: Exact two-idempotent fibers of finite-field spin factors
